Welcome

About The Department of Philosophy and Humanities

The Department of Philosophy and Humanities offers a B.A. major in Philosophy, B.A. minors in Classical Studies, Medical Humanities and Bioethics, and Philosophy. The Department also offers certificates in both Ethics and Medical Humanities, as well as language instruction in Greek and Latin. The department is large enough to offer a full range of courses and small enough that every major can receive individual attention.
